bio: A balcony jungle in a city apartment. Cuttings, repotting and the small joy of a new leaf.
avatar: Portrait of a woman in her early 30s with a headscarf and gardening gloves smiling among green leaves, soft daylight, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a lush balcony garden with potted plants and hanging vines in morning light, subject across the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Repotting a monstera
videos.description: Roots, soil and a bigger home for a big plant.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of hands repotting a large monstera into a terracotta pot with fresh soil on newspaper, bright daylight, no face, no text
videos.motion: Hands lift the plant and settle it in the new pot, soil crumbles, leaves sway softly, slow top-down drift.

videos.title: Balcony garden, morning watering
videos.description: A watering can, dew on leaves and the city waking up behind.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a lush apartment balcony garden with herbs and flowers, a watering can sprinkling water, a city skyline blurred behind, morning light, no face, no text
videos.motion: Water sprinkles down and droplets sparkle on the leaves, the plants sway gently, slow camera push-in.

videos.title: A cutting learns to root
videos.description: Time-lapse feeling: a pothos cutting in a jar of water.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a pothos cutting in a glass jar of water by a window, white roots visible, soft daylight, no people, no text
videos.motion: Light shifts slowly across the jar and the leaves sway subtly, gentle push-in.

videos.title: Tomatoes on the fire escape
videos.description: Ripening tomatoes against a brick wall.
videos.still: Wide photograph of cherry tomato plants with ripe red tomatoes growing in pots on a metal fire escape against a brick wall, warm evening light, no people, no text
videos.motion: Warm light shifts across the tomatoes, leaves rustle in a breeze, slow gentle push-in.

stories.still: Vertical macro photograph of a new unfurling green leaf with water droplets, soft light, no text

stories.still: Vertical photograph of a stack of terracotta pots on a balcony floor, warm light, no people, no text
